name: Scalability, Concurrency & Resilience
description: Engineering high-throughput, fault-tolerant backend systems: Horizontal scaling and stateless design, Circuit Breaker patterns (Resilience4j/Polly), exponential backoff with full jitter, Bulkhead resource isolation, asynchronous concurrency (thread safety, race conditions, goroutines/async-await), database connection pool sizing (HikariCP/PgBouncer), load balancing algorithms, graceful degradation, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), and distributed lock concurrency (Redlock, optimistic/pessimistic locking).

subskills.name: Horizontal Scaling & Stateless Design
subskills.description: Stateless service design, session offloading to distributed stores (Redis), shared-nothing architecture, and horizontal scaling limits.

subskills.name: Retry Policies, Backoff & Jitter
subskills.description: Exponential backoff algorithms, full jitter vs decorrelated jitter, retry budgets, and preventing cascading retry storms against failing downstream services.

subskills.name: Connection Pooling & Sizing
subskills.description: Database connection pool mechanics (HikariCP, PgBouncer, SQLAlchemy pool), thread-to-connection ratios, pool exhaustion troubleshooting, and connection leak detection.

subskills.name: Circuit Breaker Pattern
subskills.description: Circuit state machines (Closed, Open, Half-Open), failure rate thresholds, slow call duration limits, Resilience4j, and fallback response execution.

subskills.name: Bulkhead Pattern & Resource Isolation
subskills.description: Isolating thread pools, semaphore execution limits, memory compartmentalization, and preventing one degraded dependency from exhausting server resources.

subskills.name: Concurrency, Threads & Asynchronous I/O
subskills.description: Non-blocking event loops (Node.js/Netty), goroutines and channels (Go), async/await task scheduling, thread safety, race conditions, and deadlocks.

subskills.name: Load Balancing Algorithms
subskills.description: Round Robin, Weighted Least Connections, IP Hash, and Consistent Hashing algorithms for distributing traffic across backend server pools.

subskills.name: Graceful Degradation & Load Shedding
subskills.description: Load shedding under extreme saturation (HTTP 503 / 429), feature flags to disable non-critical functionality, and cached fallback responses.

subskills.name: Disaster Recovery (RPO/RTO)
subskills.description: Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) calculation, active-passive vs active-active multi-region failover strategies.

subskills.name: Distributed Locking & Concurrency Control
subskills.description: Optimistic locking (@Version column), pessimistic locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE), distributed locks using Redis (Redlock algorithm) or ZooKeeper.
